curriculum_objectives_used.description: Plot linear graphs using a table of values
Plot linear graphs and interpret real-world linear graphs
Recognise, draw and interpret graphs showing constant rates of change
Calculate the gradient and y-intercept of a linear graph; find equations in the form y = mx + c
Solve problems in context by drawing and interpreting real-life linear graphs
Plot graphs of quadratic functions using a table
Graph quadratic functions and interpret quadratic graphs
Understand the relationship between quadratic graphs and equations
Make connections between quadratic equations and their graphical representations
Apply quadratic equations and graphs to solve real-world problems

units.unit_name: Expansion and factorisation using special algebraic identities
learning_objectives: Expand simple algebraic expressions using special identities.
Factorise algebraic expressions using special identities.
Apply special algebraic identities to solve basic equations and problems.
Explain the steps taken during expansion and factorisation processes.
